title: Pure Nouvelles

allow.Patissciel Couverture: The one Patissciel card Concours de Cuisine needs: it goes to the opponent's field in Attack Position, where the Nouvelles Ritual Monsters tribute it. The page's core combo is built on this pair.

summary: Nouvelles Ritual Monsters with their Recipe Spells and Traps and generic staples. Nouvelles monsters tribute the opponent's Attack Position monsters to summon the next, bigger Nouvelles. Chef de Nouvelles, the newest card, searches a non-Pendulum Nouvelles card as a Scale. On the field it raises a monster's Level and, when the opponent Special Summons, uses a Recipe from the hand, Deck or GY to Ritual Summon. Angry Burger, also new, counts as Hungry Burger and searches a Nouvelles monster from the hand. The page's opening uses Concours de Cuisine, which needs a Patissciel Pendulum, so one Patissciel Couverture sits in the Extra Deck as an allowed card; Concours puts it on the opponent's field to be tributed. Nouvelles Recipe Book is not out in the TCG yet.

exclude.Nouvelles Recipe Book \"Recettes de Nouv: Not yet released in the TCG.

main: Starter: searches a Level 1 Ritual Monster or a Recipe card when summoned.
Newest card: as a Scale, searches a Nouvelles card; Ritual Summons when they Special Summon.
Level 1 Ritual: digs five cards for a Nouvelles card.
Level 4 Ritual: shuffles three GY cards into the Deck.
Level 5 Ritual: searches a Nouvelles or Recipe card; tributes their monster for Baelgrill.
Level 6 Ritual: negates their field and tributes all their monsters.
New Ritual that counts as Hungry Burger: reveals to search a Nouvelles monster.
Quick-Play: summons Poissonniere to your field and Couverture to theirs.
Searches a Nouvelles monster and its matching Recipe.
Ritual Spell for any Nouvelles; with Buerillabaisse, fetches another Recipe.
Ritual Spell for any Nouvelles; with Confiras, switches their monsters to Attack Position.
Field Spell: searches a Recipe and recycles for draws.
Counter Trap: negates while you control a Nouvelles Ritual Monster.
Makes a Token at a Ritual's Level and Ritual Summons from the hand.
